title: Eden Barel - Don't Forget
htmlContent:
Tel Aviv-based multi-instrumentalist and music composer Eden Barel releases a new vibrant single, "Don't Forget." Eden immediately formed his path, instantly delicate and referencing the greats in jazz and soul. Following his recently released singles "Mid Breakfast" and "Ocean" early this year 2022.

The single "Don't Forget" is a second melody from his new EP "Mid Breakfast." His catchy rhymes and the guitar play keep us wanting more. With the perfect style and smooth voice, Eden Barel instantly touches our hearts and makes for a beautiful addition to this track.

Listen to Eden Barel's "Don't Forget" from his new EP "Mid Breakfast."
